description: Land Settlement Department - Pilikuttuwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510800 (24/0336)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
